summary: Iteration 17 — Conjoint module visual/CSS restyle to Brand Equity design system. Frontend-only testing (per request). Verified all 5 Conjoint pages now wrap in .be-root + .be-conjoint-page with paper bg (rgb(247, 244, 238) = #F7F4EE), IBM Plex fonts, BeTopbar (SWUMKT logo, data-testid='be-logo'). ConjointAnalysisTool renders 'Conjoint Analysis' header with red CTA button data-testid='conjoint-new-study'. ConjointDesignPage wizard + stepper render in BE shell. ConjointResultsPage insufficient_data state uses be-card + be-eyebrow ('● DASHBOARD LOCKED'). ConjointQualitativePage stepper renders correctly. ConjointSurveyPage (public, no-auth) uses local PublicTopbar with data-testid='conjoint-resp-topbar' showing 'SWU · Marketing Research / CONJOINT ANALYSIS · ANONYMOUS'. Brand Equity regression: /brand-equity list and /showcase/e936845d9491 both render correctly — no CSS leak. All selectors resolved on first try, 0 page errors, no UI regressions.

minor.issue: Repeating 404 'Error loading prompt settings: AxiosError' in console on multiple Conjoint pages — pre-existing (not related to this iteration's restyle) but pollutes console. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: Scope isolation of .be-root CSS overrides (brand-equity-styles.css lines ~113–170) works as intended — sharp corners/paper bg only apply within .be-root. Verified Dashboard and non-Conjoint pages are unaffected.
All 5 Conjoint pages consistently import BeTopbar from '@/pages/brand-equity/be-components' and brand-equity-styles.css — good reuse, single source of truth.

ConjointSurveyPage uses a local PublicTopbar component (lines 134–155) rather than BeTopbar because public route does not have authenticated user; acceptable inline solution. Testid 'conjoint-resp-topbar' resolves correctly.
Minor: BeTopbar's data-testid='be-logo' is applied inside the shared component — all 4 authenticated Conjoint pages inherit correctly without additional wiring.
File sizes: ConjointResultsPage.js still large (~2400+ lines) — carry-over from earlier iterations, unrelated to this restyle. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 test points: all 5 Conjoint pages verified + BE list + Showcase regression)
